# `raceFirstWithSleepToTimeout`

Suggests Effect.timeoutOrElse when Effect.raceFirst has exactly one sleep- or delay-based timer arm

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377121` |
| Language Service name | `raceFirstWithSleepToTimeout` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/race-first-with-sleep-to-timeout` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const request: Effect.Effect<string, Error>

export const result = Effect.raceFirst(
/**
                      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(race-first-with-sleep-to-timeout): This Effect first-completion race has exactly one sleep- or delay-based timer arm. `Effect.timeoutOrElse` expresses the timeout and fallback directly.
*/
  request,
  Effect.sleep("5 seconds").pipe(
    Effect.andThen(Effect.fail(new Error("request timed out")))
  )
)
```
